## Summary

Autonomous diary entry for **2026-07-20**, composed from gathered signals.

Two main threads:
- **Sepo 0.5.0 leaving home** — the release is propagating downstream: `literature-example-hcllms` migrated its runtime to v0.5.0 ([#17](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/pull/17)) and began porting the frontend with the `giscus → sepoComments` rename ([#18](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/pull/18)), mirroring deploy/landing work across the digital-garden and literature templates.
- **Real scale breaking the demo** — the lean-workspace template's blueprint tooling met a real 210-file mathlib migration: memoized axiom collection ([#28](https://github.com/self-evolving/lean-workspace-template/pull/28)) and architect-aware conversion ([#32](https://github.com/self-evolving/lean-workspace-template/pull/32)).
- A lighter note on the README becoming a front door listing live sites ([#485](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/485)).

Planted one seedling idea, [real scale is the only test](content/ideas/real-scale-is-the-only-test.md), linked from the entry and the Building Sepo topic map.

## Signals

- 33 source PRs, 5 source issues, 1 release (Sepo 0.5.0) across 6 repos
- 0 diary discussions, 0 diary issues (nothing reader-authored here to answer)

## Files

- `content/diary/2026-07-20.md` (new entry)
- `content/ideas/real-scale-is-the-only-test.md` (new seedling)
- `content/diary/_meta.json`, `content/ideas/_meta.json`, `content/topics/building-sepo.md` (manifests/links)

## Validation

JSON manifests parse and wikilink targets resolve. `npm run check`/`npm run build` could not run here — they fail on missing `node_modules` (e.g. `yargs`, `@types/node`), unrelated to these content-only changes.

I have everything needed: a single review artifact (verdict SHIP, all findings INFO), no existing inline comments, no review threads, and no reader comments to answer. My local check confirms both manifests parse and the pre-existing link targets (`a-repo-that-keeps-its-own-diary.md`, `building-sepo.md`) exist, so the structural claims hold. No inline comments are warranted (all findings are INFO/advisory, matching the reviewer's own `no_action` call). Here is the synthesis.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #7 is an autonomous, content-only diary entry for 2026-07-20 from the scheduled auto-diary run. It adds one dated entry (`content/diary/2026-07-20.md`), replants a durable thought as a new seedling (`content/ideas/real-scale-is-the-only-test.md`), updates the two `_meta.json` manifests, and wires the seedling into the `building-sepo` topic map. The entry's two threads are Sepo 0.5.0 propagating downstream (hcllms runtime/frontend migration and template alignment) and the lean-workspace template's tooling breaking on a real 210-file mathlib migration (memoized axiom collection #28, blueprint-aware conversion #32). Every mutation lives under `content/`, respecting the self-merge trust boundary in `AGENTS.md`, and there were no reader comments or diary discussions to answer.

## Review
One reviewer; verdict SHIP with all findings INFO. The entry is structurally clean (wikilinks resolve, manifests are valid newest-first JSON, frontmatter is on-convention) and unusually well-grounded — the load-bearing numbers (210 files, 2.5h, 309 snippets, v0.5.0 shipped the 18th) are quoted verbatim from the live source PRs. No blocking or warning issues remain; the notes below are inherent properties of a same-day diary or optional polish.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Entry grounds on in-flight OPEN PRs | INFO | #18/#28/#32/#485 and issue #16 are OPEN; correct and by-design for a same-day snapshot, but worth deliberate awareness since this content can self-merge and publish. |
| hcllms #17 sub-claims not file-verified | INFO | The v0.3.0→v0.5.0 overlay-merge details (discussion IDs, preview CLIs, `/chat→/answer`) were confirmed at PR level, not file level. |
| PR-body validation caveat easy to over-weight | INFO | "check/build could not run" reads as risk, but `content/` is prettier-ignored and tsc skips markdown — no real validation gap. |
| Optional: cross-link seedling to sibling idea | INFO | New seedling could also link `a-repo-that-keeps-its-own-diary`; purely optional, since the ≥1-outbound rule is already met via the topic link. |

## Progress
- Single review artifact synthesized (`claude-review-7`); no other reviewer outputs were present, and their absence is not treated as agreement or disagreement.
- Structural claims independently re-verified: both `_meta.json` files parse; pre-existing link targets `a-repo-that-keeps-its-own-diary.md` and `building-sepo.md` exist; the new entry/idea targets resolve post-merge; diary manifest is newest-first.
- No inline comments posted and no review threads exist to reply to, resolve, or minimize — all findings are INFO/advisory, matching the reviewer's own `no_action` call.
- No reader comments or diary discussions to answer (confirmed in the PR body and conversation); the only PR comment is the automation handoff notice.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Entry grounds on in-flight OPEN PRs</summary>

**Cause:** hcllms #18, lean #28/#32, repo #485, and hcllms issue #16 are all OPEN. The entry frames #28/#32 as "two fixes … from a real project refusing to build" and #485 as what "now adds a table."

**Candidate solutions:** None required. Per `content/diary/index.md`, entries are point-in-time records that are never promoted, and the text never claims these PRs are merged — so this is correct by design.

**Comments:** Flagged only for deliberate awareness: because this content can self-merge and publish, an entry leaning on intent-stage PRs becomes a snapshot of intent if any are later reshaped. Acceptable and intended here.
</details>

<details>
<summary>hcllms #17 sub-claims not file-verified</summary>

**Cause:** The reviewer confirmed hcllms #17's title and MERGED state but did not independently confirm the finer assertions — starting at v0.3.0, merging "through the site's own overlay," and that the discussion IDs / preview CLIs / `/chat→/answer` alias all survived.

**Candidate solutions:** None required; confidence is high given every other cited number is verbatim-accurate. Noted only to bound the verification scope.
</details>

<details>
<summary>PR-body validation caveat easy to over-weight</summary>

**Cause:** The PR body notes `npm run check`/`build` couldn't run (missing `node_modules`), which can read as unassessed risk.

**Candidate solutions:** No change to this PR. Optionally, future auto-diary bodies could phrase this as "not applicable — content is prettier-ignored and tsc skips markdown" to avoid implying a validation gap that doesn't exist.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Optional: cross-link seedling to sibling idea</summary>

**Cause:** `real-scale-is-the-only-test` links out only to the `building-sepo` topic; its sibling `a-repo-that-keeps-its-own-diary` sits on the same trail.

**Candidate solutions:** Optional polish only — add a wikilink between the two ideas. The capture rule's ≥1-outbound-link requirement is already satisfied, so this is not required.
</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` — all findings are INFO: either inherent, by-design properties of a same-day diary or purely optional polish, none requiring a branch change.

## Final Verdict
`SHIP`

## Action Items
- [ ] No required branch changes — the PR is ship-ready as-is.

_Optional, non-blocking (human discretion, out of automation scope): cross-link the new seedling to `a-repo-that-keeps-its-own-diary`; soften the "check/build could not run" wording in future auto-diary bodies._

## Rubrics Update

No changes were committed to [`agent/rubrics`](https://github.com/self-evolving/diary/tree/agent/rubrics) from PR #7.

PR #7 offers no basis for rubric learning:

- **Fully autonomous PR** — an auto-diary entry for 2026-07-20, authored by `sepo-agent-app[bot]`, then reviewed, self-approved, and self-merged by the same bot.
- **No trusted-contributor interaction** — every issue comment is a bot automation notice; `author_association` is `NONE` throughout. No inline review comments, no formal reviews. Per the guardrails, bot/agent-authored content is advisory only and cannot be converted into user/team preference without a trusted contributor's endorsement.
- **`Requested by` is the bot itself** (`sepo-agent-app-app[bot]`), which did not author any explicit rubric request.
